conditional_responsibilities.duties: Preserve both medics, both western clearers and every staffed hostile corridor. Lava still inherits the completed lower-clearance slot. Durin is the selected reserve for Steward's vacant [2,7] UP position when 12 DP is available.
conditional_responsibilities.execution_boundary: This is an observed-loss recovery instruction, not an assumed conditional feature of the fixed action compiler. Executing it requires an explicit revised action stream; do not claim that the listed timeline automatically performs it or guarantees sufficient replacement damage.
conditional_responsibilities.failure_classification: The primary survival hypothesis is falsified. Report the lost damage window and any resulting clearance or interception dependency.

formation_structure.artillery: Steward supplies continuous eastern vertical coverage. Lava supplies materially stronger secondary output than the former misplaced Durin assignment. Passing hostiles can still compete for attacks; no artillery priority or splash damage is assumed.
formation_structure.medical: Ansel at [2,6] UP and Hibiscus at [5,6] DOWN cover each other, both central vanguards, Steward and Lava. Their baseline coverage does not include either western clearer or the outer defenders.
formation_structure.opening: Fang and Vanilla face across adjacent central lanes. Melantha intercepts upper outer traffic; Midnight intercepts lower traffic while reaching restraint #4 two columns ahead. Lancet covers Midnight and Vanilla.
formation_structure.protected_routes: Eastern clearance belongs to Melantha and Midnight. Gallus clears western upper restraint #1; Castle clears western lower restraint #2. Their delayed placements avoid deliberately beginning western work during the initial western artillery stops.
formation_structure.terminal: Beagle and Cardigan retain the outer corridors. Fang, Vanilla, both medics and Steward remain deployed. Lava's slot passes to redeployed Midnight for central clearance after the artillery duty is complete.

formation_transitions.transition: Lancet leaves before Steward deploys. Ansel is already treating the central formation; Midnight must have enough remaining HP to complete its opening duel.
Melantha leaves only after the upper opening hostiles and restraint #3 are actually cleared. The next upper outer spawn is at frame 3330.
Gallus's completed upper western clearance releases its slot to Beagle at [1,3]. Beagle must intercept the first paired officer before it passes that position.
Castle's completed lower western clearance releases its slot to Lava. An unfinished restraint #2 invalidates this handoff.
Midnight yields the same lower blocking tile to Cardigan. Restraint #4 must already be destroyed; Cardigan does not inherit adjacent-device clearance.
After recorded artillery destruction, Lava yields its slot to Midnight at [4,5] LEFT. Midnight has completed 70 seconds off field. Existing central blockers remain in place.

mandatory_tactical_invariants.requirement: Every selected operator belongs to normal_low_star_catalog, has identity.rarity 1-3 and qualification.normal_mode true. Use only listed debug configurations and supported effects.
All action tiles are integer [row,col]. Never deploy on [1,2], [6,2], [1,6] or [6,6].
Never exceed eight occupied deployment slots. No refunds or unsupported DP are budgeted. Vanguard death before a credited grant invalidates dependent deployments.
Ordinary operators neither attack nor block civilians. Do not assume civilian healing, safe officer targeting, or safe arrival merely from destroying a restraint.
Record destruction of #3 before Melantha leaves, #4 before Cardigan replaces Midnight, #1 before Gallus leaves, and #2 before Castle leaves.

Both medics must remain alive and deliver actual treatment. Steward's output must continue beyond the prior frame-3480 death window; Lava is an additional attacker, not evidence that Steward survived.

Completion predicates are verification gates, not simulator-supported conditional commands. A missed gate falsifies the fixed candidate; do not silently execute a failed handoff and label the intended prerequisite satisfied.
Require remaining_life > 0, zero leaks, exhausted spawns, no active enemies, zero protected-target deaths and exactly two safe protected-target arrivals. Record operator deaths separately.

revised_operational_plans.tactical_thesis: Clear eastern restraints with the outer interceptors, then clear both western restraints during the artillery's eastern excursion. Earlier mutual medical coverage must sustain Steward; Lava supplies a second substantial artillery damage source. Fresh outer defenders preserve interception while both civilians complete their entire routes. Retain the central vanguards and medical core through the final spawns, then redeploy Midnight for sustained central clearance. Completion deadlines are falsifiable tactical predictions, not assumed kills or executable conditional guards.

revised_stage_understanding.causal_revision: The previous eastern secondary attacker supplied little artillery damage, lower eastern clearance never completed, and medical deaths invalidated later damage and handoffs. This revision assigns all four devices separately, advances opening treatment, uses Midnight for lower eastern clearance and adds Lava as a substantial second artillery attacker.
revised_stage_understanding.current_model_rules: Civilians are neutral and ordinary operators cannot attack or block them. Officers can attack them within 1.2. Restraints specially detain civilians until destroyed. Civilian deaths deduct objective life; safe arrivals do not leak or deduct life.
revised_stage_understanding.gamedata_facts: Four ordinary-targetable restraints occupy the forbidden device tiles. Civilian routes encounter an eastern and a western restraint. The artillery follows a western opening, eastern excursion and western return.

revised_stage_understanding.verification_status: Unsimulated candidate. Shell inspection was blocked by the local sandbox launcher; the plan uses supplied evidence and a static DP calculation.

falsifiers: Either western clearer dies or misses its device handoff.

revised_strategic_hypotheses.hypothesis: Separate eastern interception from delayed western clearance so both civilians can finish complete routes during the artillery's eastern excursion. Earlier medical establishment must sustain Steward long enough for Lava to complete the artillery kill, while fresh outer defenders and redeployed Midnight preserve full-stage interception and clearance.

revised_tactical_requirements.artillery: Both medics must survive, Steward must continue beyond frame 3480, and combined observed damage must destroy the artillery by frame 4950.
revised_tactical_requirements.deadline_status: Chosen tactical requirements derived from route duties and slot handoffs; none is asserted as an observed result.
revised_tactical_requirements.economy: Static deployment affordability passes using natural DP, Fang's supported automatic grants and Vanilla activations at seconds 25,55,85,115. No refund is credited; survival and actual skill execution remain prerequisites.
revised_tactical_requirements.opening: Preserve both vanguards and all credited early DP grants; establish Lancet at second 33 and Ansel at second 44.
revised_tactical_requirements.protected_targets: Require both complete safe arrivals, predicted by frame 4350, independently of artillery destruction.
revised_tactical_requirements.terminal: Retain central blocking and medical coverage through the frame-6330 final spawn and subsequent clearance.

changed_responsibilities: Midnight replaces Plume as the opening lower interceptor and eastern lower restraint attacker.

revision_hypothesis.if_expected_event_absent: Inspect both lower restraint destruction events, Midnight's survival and the lower interception handoff before attributing the absence to timing. A release without safe arrival does not verify protection. Missing arrival falsifies the protected-route hypothesis; retain concurrent interception and medical duties, and do not claim that later artillery destruction or device clearance repairs the failed objective.
revision_hypothesis.tactical_hypothesis: Dedicated clearance of all four restraints, earlier mutually covered medical support, Midnight's lower eastern device attacks and Lava's additional artillery damage can preserve both protected routes without abandoning late hostile interception.
